title: Zara and the Commonwealth Shared Scholarship
caption: A 1-year UK master's with full tuition, return flights and a monthly allowance 🇬🇧 Commonwealth Shared Scholarships, for students living in developing Commonwealth countries. Closes 8 Dec 2026, 16:00 GMT. Comment LINK 👇 #commonwealth #scholarship #studyinuk #fullyfunded

scenes.backdrop: rainy London-style street at evening with red phone box and glowing shop windows

beats.text: Quddus, I practised my British accent. Cheerio, old chap! Fancy a spot of tea?
beats.say: Kuddus, I practised my British accent. Cheerio, old chap! Fancy a spot of tea?
Very nice. Now let's get you a scholarship to use it. The Commonwealth Shared Scholarship.
Tuition, flights, and money every month?

beats.text: Plus arrival and thesis allowances. It's for a one-year master's at a UK university.
beats.say: Plus arrival and thesis allowances. It's for a one-year master's at a U.K. university.

scenes.backdrop: cozy British tea room with teapots, cakes and lace curtains

beats.text: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries who live in a developing Commonwealth country. Usually with a two-one degree or higher, and you must show you can't afford UK study without it.
beats.say: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries who live in a developing Commonwealth country. Usually with a two-one degree or higher, and you must show you can't afford U.K. study without it.
Only courses on their list for this year. So pick from the list first.
Course list opened. Spot of tea: postponed!
